searches_conducted: 50+ distinct web_search queries across 5 parallel research agents covering Reddit (r/Etsy, r/EtsySellers), Etsy Community forums (community.etsy.com), Medium, Substack, Indie Hackers, YouTube, podcast directories, Trustpilot, and news outlets (Kiplinger, NPR, EcommerceBytes, ValueAddedResource).
verification_rounds: Two dedicated verification subagents were deployed to re-fetch and confirm character-for-character accuracy of snippets for all Part 1 findings. All 13 Part 1 snippets were confirmed verbatim against loaded page content.
access_barriers_encountered:
- **Reddit:** All reddit.com URLs returned permissions errors on automated fetch. No Reddit content was directly verified.
- **community.etsy.com:** All forum threads require login after Bevy platform migration. Content was retrievable from Google's search index cache of the original URLs.
- **srcreativestudio.com:** Returned 415 error on automated fetch. Content confirmed from Google's search index.
- **Medium paywall:** Several Medium articles are member-only; key passages were above the paywall and confirmed.
- **Trustpilot pagination:** Review pages are dynamically ordered; specific page numbers shift as new reviews are posted.

11point_qa_checklist_applied_to_all_find:
1. ✅ One finding = one source, one voice (multi-speaker pages split)
2. ✅ Verbatim snippets are single continuous passages (no concatenation)
3. ✅ What fields are fully supported by cited snippets (no derived math, no inferred categories)
4. ✅ Source fields are complete URLs with protocol + domain + path
5. ✅ Notes are local-only (no cross-source context, no math, no references to other findings)
6. ✅ Qualifiers preserved where visible in snippet (dates, currency, thresholds, tenure, country, tools)
7. ✅ No absence inferred from inaccessible pages (F-X13 is an active search absence finding)
8. ✅ Edge cases applied: journalist-captured quote (F-11) classified as article; intermediary articles for Reddit classified as could_not_verify; Google index of blocked URLs classified as blocked_url_index_verified
9. ✅ All Part 1 and Part 2 findings dated within April 2025–April 2026 window (F-X03 and F-X12 excluded for date noncompliance)
10. ✅ Verification status correctly assigned per evidence quality
11. ✅ source_type values drawn exclusively from allowed list

known_gaps:
- No directly verified Reddit content due to systematic access barrier.
- No verified video transcript content; YouTube pages could not be fetched for transcripts.
- No verified podcast episode transcripts; only show-level descriptions accessible.
- Trustpilot reviews with imprecise dates were conservatively degraded to Part 4.
- Etsy community forum content is dependent on Google's search index cache, which may not reflect post-migration URL structures.
